mapper.select: SELECT replacement_request_id, service_key, old_client_id, new_client_id, request_fingerprint, completed_at FROM iam_reserved_service_client_replacements WHERE replacement_request_id = #{replacementRequestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_reserved_service_client_replacements (replacement_request_id, service_key, old_client_id, new_client_id, request_fingerprint, completed_at) VALUES (#{row.replacementRequestId}, #{row.serviceKey}, #{row.oldClientId}, #{row.newClientId}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.completedAt})
